home.title: Find what you need. Even if you don't know its name.
home.lead: Search with words or a photo, compare what's on offer, buy it or have it found for you, and ship it. The full delivered price before you pay.
home.finderTitle: Describe it, or send a photo. We'll find it for you.
home.trendingLead: Ordered by several customers in the last {days} days.
home.photoTitle: Have a photo of it? That's enough to start.
home.photoLead: Add a photo or a short video, or describe it in your own words. Tracecart works out what it is and shows the closest products, with why each one matches.

ship.title: Ship something
ship.body: Send goods you already have: we estimate the cargo, quote it, and handle pickup, transport and customs.

sell.title: Sell on Tracecart
sell.body: List your products, reach buyers in several countries, and get paid once orders are delivered.

business.title: Buy for a company
business.body: Company accounts, colleagues who order, approvals, bulk orders, requests for quotes and Net 30.

carry.title: Carry with Tracecart
carry.body: Run trucks, vans or freight? Carry for Tracecart's customers on your routes, at your rates.

compare.title: Compare products
compare.lead: Up to four products side by side, with what each one lists.
compare.empty: Nothing to compare yet. Choose Compare on a product to add it here.
compare.one: Pick at least one more product to compare.
compare.notice: This shows what each product lists. A dash means it doesn't say. It doesn't tell you that one product replaces or fits another: ask us when that matters.

saved.title: Saved
saved.signIn: Sign in to see what you saved
saved.empty: Nothing saved yet. Choose Save on a product to keep it here.

fit.noneListed: Nothing is listed for this part yet. Check it below, or ask us.

result.insufficient: We can't confirm it fits your {target}.

fit.notSure: "May fit" or not listed isn't the same as "doesn't fit": we only say it fits when a manufacturer document, an OEM reference or our own test shows it.

parts.title: Find parts for what you own
parts.lead: Your vehicle, your laptop or phone, your appliance: see the parts listed to fit it. Those verified come first.
parts.verifiedLead: Each rests on a manufacturer document, an OEM reference or a test by Tracecart.
parts.noneVerified: No part is verified for it yet.
parts.potentialLead: Listed by the seller, or something is missing to be sure. Check before you buy, or ask us.
